name: playnt
description: Post-market complaint triage for a fictional medical device manufacturer. Synthetic data. Not a validated quality management system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web "npm run demo -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
